>

Newline-delimited JSON, one event per line, kept open until the client goes away. `since`
first replays the events nyxd keeps in memory (the last 1000). A client that falls behind
receives `{"type":"events_dropped"}` and is disconnected. Container actions: create, start,
die, oom, restart, health_status, remove; image actions: pull, build, remove.
